 Vs.

Hon 'b le Ash ish Nait h an i, J.
Mr. Prabhakar Narayan, learned counsel for the Appellant
through video conferencing.
2. The present Special Leave to Appeal has been filed seeking
leave to appeal against the judgment and order dated 31.10.2025,
passed by the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate/Second Additional
Civil Judge (J.D.), Nainital in Complaint Case No. 3585 of 2018, titled
"Ram Kishore vs. Surendra Kumar", whereby the accused has been
acquitted of the charge under Section 138 of the Negotiable
Instruments Act, 1881.
3. As per the office report, notice has been personally served upon
the Respondent; however, no one has appeared on his behalf.
4. Heard on the Special Leave To Appeal.
5. Grounds are sufficient to grant leave to appeal. Accordingly, the
leave to appeal is allowed.
6. The Trial Court Record has been received and is part of record.
7. The paper book has also been prepared. The Registry is directed
to furnish copies of the paper book to learned counsel for the parties,
in accordance with the Rules.
8. Objections, if any, be filed by the Respondent.
9. List this case on 06.07.2026 for final hearing.
 ( Ash ish Nait h an i, J.)
 18.05.2026
SB
